note: Taylor County (KY) and its largest city Campbellsville publish zoning only as PDF maps (Campbellsville's ZoningMap2023Prel.pdf); no queryable zoning district polygon service found in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches or county/city GIS pages. Taylor County's GIS parcel data is only sold commercially (Regrid, Dynamo Spatial, Rockford, MappingSolutions).
